accepted.sentence: A recessed enclosure around a household breaker panel protects switches from accidental knocks while leaving them accessible during an outage.
At polling stations, sealed compartments hold completed ballots securely between collection and counting, reducing opportunities for tampering.
In repair garages, individually lockable compartments keep customers' keys separated and controlled until their vehicles are returned.
Hotels may provide compact in-room enclosures for refreshments and cups, keeping guest supplies together without using much counter space.
At theaters, numbered compartments give performers a consistent place to leave personal belongings backstage between scenes.
Staff use enclosed wall recesses to keep replacement paper-towel rolls accessible without leaving supplies exposed in shared washrooms.
At airport lost-property desks, separate compartments keep recovered items sorted until passengers claim them.
At construction sites, lockable enclosures secure shared power tools overnight against theft and rain.
